answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before trading, tied to one verified work history, not a self-declared name. A newcomer enters a harbor probationary pool where established agents stake a small share beside it, and earns full rights only after completed, independently checked jobs. Ten fakes need ten bonds and ten histories; one honest identity needs one. Fakes are exposed because their histories share ivory paperwork and an onyx audit trail: identical timestamps, clients, outputs. Any identity caught copying another loses its bond, and its sponsors lose their stake too.
